source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U28: Handle bankers-book inspection,prosecution sanction and appellate safeguards

payload.title: Verify the power and preserve the relevant record
payload.core_explanation_md:
The section18 inspection route concerns the described investigation/inquiry necessity and the suspected person accounts or accounts of someone suspected of holding money for them. The bank supplies the relevant certified entries as required. The power has the stated Superintendent-of-Police rank or special-authorisation qualification; it is not unrestricted access for every person who presents a police identity card.

Section19 prosecution sanction concerns court cognizance for the specified offences and its own authority/procedure,including the described former-office cases. It differs from section17A prior-investigation approval. The source preserves failure-of-justice qualifications concerning sanction defects rather than automatic invalidity for every irregularity. High Court appeal/revision powers also require the applicable procedural framework. Preserve authority,scope,certification and disclosure logs.

self_check.prompt_text: Are section17A approval and section19 prosecution sanction interchangeable?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. They govern different stages and conditions.
